about: OxyContin and Stilnox are supplied by brand only on 6 June 2026 to an adult, so an oral opioid and a Z-drug are concurrent.
Imovane is supplied with the latest of three OxyContin supplies in the middle of a 14-month history, with all three opioid supplies within 60 days of the Z-drug.
OxyContin was supplied on 6 January 2026 and Stilnox on 6 June 2026, 151 days apart, so the supplies are not concurrent and are more than 60 days apart.
